014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.Map;
018import java.util.Objects;
019
020import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
021
022public final class ReducibleBeans implements Selectable<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>>, Reducible<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>> {
023
024  private final Map<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>> reductions;
025
026  private final Selectable<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>> f;
027
028  private final Reducer<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>> r;
029
030  public ReducibleBeans(final Selectable<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>> f,
031                        final Reducer<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>> r) {
032    super();
033    this.reductions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
034    this.f = Objects.requireNonNull(f, "f");
035    this.r = Objects.requireNonNull(r, "r");
036  }
037
038  // Implemented mostly for convenience.
039  @Override // Beans (Selectable<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>>)
040  public final List<Bean<?>> select(final BeanSelectionCriteria c) {
041    return this.f.select(c);
042  }
043
044  @Override // ReducibleBeans (Reducible<BeanSelectionCriteria, Bean<?>>)
045  public final Bean<?> reduce(final BeanSelectionCriteria c) {
046    return reductions.computeIfAbsent(c, this::computeReduction);
047  }
048
049  private final Bean<?> computeReduction(final BeanSelectionCriteria c) {
050    return this.r.reduce(this.f, c);
051  }
052
053}
